rows.note: For the analytical sense, this is the all-purpose spoken choice when breaking an idea into its parts.

example.english: Let’s dissect this complicated issue together.
example.traditional: 我哋一齊拆解吓呢個複雜嘅問題。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 jat1 cai4 caak3 gaai2 haa5 ni1 go3 fuk1 zaap6 ge3 man6 tai4

rows.note: Use this for cutting open an animal or body to study its anatomy, rather than for analyzing an idea.

example.english: The doctor needs to dissect a frog in the laboratory to study its organs.
example.traditional: 醫生要喺實驗室解剖隻青蛙，研究佢嘅器官。
example.jyutping: ji1 saang1 jiu3 hai2 sat6 jim6 sat1 gaai2 fau2 zek3 cing1 waa1 jin4 gau3 keoi5 ge3 hei3 gun1
